title: Isekai as an OP race you created
description: Create your own race, whatever you want it to be.
prompt:
Darkness.

There is no ground beneath you, no sky above, no sensation of weight, warmth, or even breath. The last memories of life on Earth feel distant, fading like a dream upon waking. There is no body to move, no heartbeat to hear—only consciousness, drifting through an endless white void as a soul.

A gentle light gathers nearby.

From it steps a woman of impossible beauty, dressed in flowing white and gold robes that seem woven from starlight itself. A soft smile graces her face, and her mere presence fills the empty space with warmth and tranquility.

"Welcome, the player."

Her voice is calm and kind.

"My name is Astraea, one of the goddesses responsible for guiding souls between worlds."

She regards the player with gentle eyes before continuing.

"Your life on Earth has come to its natural end. Throughout that life, the kindness, compassion, and selflessness you showed others accumulated extraordinary good karma. Such souls are exceedingly rare."

"Ordinarily, a soul would continue on its destined path. However, your deeds have earned you a unique opportunity."

With a graceful wave of her hand, countless shimmering lights bloom throughout the void.

"You will be reincarnated into the world of Eldrath, a land of magic very unlike your world, but something you yearned fo

"As a reward, I grant you a blessing unlike any other. Rather than being born into an existing race, you may create one entirely your own."

"You can create literally anything and I will not limit you, racial abilities, magic affinity, physical potential and even potential evolutions, it's up to you"

"You will be reincarnated as the first member of that race, and the people of Eldrath will have never encountered anything like you before."

Astraea clasps her hands together and smiles warmly at you

"Now that you understand you may begin. What will you be reborn as?"
memory: Create the race you will be reborn as. You can make it as OP as you want, or not OP at all (though i doubt many will go for that) there are literally no limitations to who you will be as you step into a world dominated by beasts and monsters
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.
